close_reason: Implemented close command with dependency enforcement: validates issue IDs, checks for open children before allowing close, 34 tests, 12 agent files updated
description: Make bd close respect the dependency graph as a hard gate, not advisory. When closing an issue: 1) Check all --deps are in closed status. 2) Check all child test subtasks are closed (quality gate integration). 3) If any blocking deps are still open, refuse to close and print what's blocking. Example: 'bd close beth-gtl.3' fails with 'Cannot close — beth-gtl.2 (open) still blocking.' This is the lowest-cost, highest-value enforcement. The dependency data already exists in dolt — just needs a check in the close path. Could be implemented as a bd plugin/hook or as a wrapper script in the beth project.
title: Dependency enforcement on bd close

description: Git pre-push hook that prevents agents from pushing to branches they don't own. Mechanism: 1) Read current branch name. 2) Extract epic ID from branch (epic/<epic-id>). 3) Query beads for the epic's assignee/claimer. 4) Compare against current actor (BD_ACTOR / git user.name). 5) If mismatch, reject the push with clear error message. 6) If no claim exists on the epic, reject (untracked work). Install via .beads/hooks/ during bd init — beads already has a hook installation path. Prevents the most destructive failure mode: one agent overwriting another agent's work on a shared branch.
title: Branch guard pre-push hook

description: Single bd land <epic-id> command that enforces the entire Land the Plane checklist: 1) Run pnpm test:gate (all test suites). 2) Check exit code — fail if tests fail. 3) Verify all epic subtasks are closed via bd epic close-eligible. 4) Generate test report to docs/test-reports/. 5) git add -A && git commit. 6) git push origin epic/<epic-id>. 7) Create PR to main via GitHub MCP. 8) Print summary with PR link. Collapses the manual 8-step landing procedure into one enforceable command. Depends on dep enforcement (.1) and branch guard (.2) being in place so the push step is safe. Integrates with quality gate plan (beth-gtl) for test execution.
title: Landing gate command (bd land)
